snippet.title: Asteroids (J. Peter Hoddie) for the TI-99/4A
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

A shooter based on the popular arcade hit Asteroids. Shoot the asteroids and the smaller things that come out of them. You can also use a teleport but it teleports you to a random location.
